name: Furucombo
rootCause: Better to wait than to swing and miss. rekt gets in the ring with Limzero and Kurt Barry to investigate the $14m furucombo knockout. "Infinite approval" is never safe.

descriptions.text: Better to wait than to swing and miss. rekt gets in the ring with Limzero and Kurt Barry to investigate the $14m furucombo knockout. "Infinite approval" is never safe.

The agent of the DeFi platform Furucombo was attacked and the amount stolen amounted to more than 15 million U.S. dollars. The DeFi aggregation platform Furucombo officially released a tweet, saying: "The root cause has been found and the vulnerability has been patched. The funds are now safe. We are investigating the stolen funds and organizing follow-up actions. The follow-up will continue to be updated."Later, Furucombo stated that it would issue 5 million iouCOMBO tokens to affected users

On February 27, 2021, an attacker exploited the Furucombo DeFi protocol by leveraging an uninitialized Aave v2 implementation contract and the absence of a handler allowlist in Furucombo's proxy. This allowed malicious delegatecall execution and enabled the attacker to drain ~$14M in ERC-20 tokens from users who had previously approved the proxy. Furucombo's proxy contract accepted any user-supplied handler address for delegatecall with no on-chain allowlist. This enabled exploitation via an attacker-controlled, uninitialized Aave v2 implementation contract, allowing the attacker to execute arbitrary code and drain tokens from all users who had previously authorized the proxy.
